name: ui-click
prompt: A single short crisp click of a small wooden toggle switch being pressed, dry and close

name: ui-back
prompt: A soft low wooden thunk followed by a brief airy whoosh, like closing a small drawer

name: error-denied
prompt: A dull double knock of a rubber mallet on a hollow wooden crate, muted and low

name: worker-assign
prompt: A single sharp pickaxe strike against hard rock with a brief stony echo in a mine tunnel

name: worker-recall
prompt: Two soft boot steps scuffing backward on loose gravel in a quiet tunnel

name: worker-hire
prompt: A small brass hand bell rung twice brightly, like a foreman calling a new hire over

name: upgrade-complete
prompt: A ratchet wrench clicking rapidly three times then a solid metal clank as a bolt seats home

name: layer-unlock
prompt: A massive stone slab door grinding open with a deep subterranean rumble and falling pebbles

name: flare-claim
prompt: A cascade of small crystals and coins pouring and clinking into a shallow metal pan

name: flare-warning
prompt: A rising hiss of pressurized gas venting from a rock fissure with a faint deep tremor

name: coin-clink
prompt: A single small gold coin clinking once against a stack of coins on a metal surface

name: foreman-whistle
prompt: A short sharp blow of a wooden foreman's whistle, single piercing chirp with tunnel reverb

name: shift-victory
prompt: A large brass mine bell struck three times in celebration, ringing out with long cavernous reverb

name: shift-defeat
prompt: Old mine timbers creaking and groaning as they settle, ending in a low weary thud

name: undo-swipe
prompt: A quick reverse paper-like swipe, a soft fast whoosh sliding from high to low

name: bin-blocked
prompt: A heavy load of loose rock and gravel jamming and grinding to a halt inside a metal chute, ending in a dull hollow clunk, in an echoing mine tunnel

name: flare-fizzle
prompt: A burning gas flame sputtering and dying out with a soft descending hiss and a final faint pop, close and dry

name: lesson-chime
prompt: Two bright ascending notes struck on a small metal xylophone bar, clean and short with a gentle ring

name: shift-start
prompt: A steam whistle giving one short firm blast at a mine head at dawn, mid-pitched with a brief outdoor echo

name: achievement-star
prompt: A single struck crystal glass chime blooming into a shimmering sparkle tail, bright and delicate

name: away-return
prompt: A wooden hut door creaking open and a small brass bell over the door jingling once, warm and close
